seeds.data: replicate r uses seed r (0..n_rep-1); specimens SeedSequence([r, 1]), recordings SeedSequence([r, 0])

designs.three: three specimens per composition, Latin assignment (i_F + i_f) mod 3

meta.deviation_from_paper: inner LOO models of nested and group-wise jackknife+ keep the outer kernel hyperparameters and input scaling (closed form); LawGP inner law refitted warm-started; ProductGP only on the one-specimen design and only on group-wise folds and the full-grid fit; see exact_refit_check

index.results/a6_replicates.csv: one row per synthetic grid (flat metrics)
index.results/numbers_a6.tex: macros twin*: meta, parameters, calibration, replica_check, exact_refit_check, settings, optimum, truth, real_grid_vs_twin

sources.eps ratios: Koc et al. 2025 Fig. 7 as read in R1 (3 wt% = 1.57 x pristine; others below pristine, 0.90 assumed)
sources.law-true parameters: a2_common.fit_law5 on the full real V_rms grid (project notes)
sources.two-mode parameters: bounded least squares on the full real V_rms grid (this script)
sources.kappa: slope of log(y/law) on log(tap_rate_used_Hz/freq_Hz), 72 recordings
sources.sigma_j: robust SD of inter-tap intervals of the real waveforms / sqrt(2) (peaks above 40 percent of max)
sources.rho, bg ratio, delta_q: data/long.parquet (quiet samples, robust SD / V_rms, level spacing)
sources.sigma_t, sigma_a, beta: calibrated to a1 median cycle CV of V_rms, split-half log-ratio SD of V_rms, median background ratio
